_meta.note: Ground truth (which tickets are genuinely about a shipping delay) lives in data/answer_key.md, not in this file -- the pipeline should not be able to read the label off the data.

tickets.subject: Charged twice this month
tickets.body: I just noticed two separate charges of $34.99 on my card this billing cycle, both labeled Fernwood Goods. I only have one active subscription. Can you refund the duplicate?

tickets.subject: Order #4471 way behind schedule
tickets.body: The label for my order was created five days ago but the carrier tracking hasn't moved since then. Package is late and I really need it before the weekend for a gift.

tickets.subject: Password reset email never arrives
tickets.body: I've requested a password reset three times in the last hour and nothing shows up in my inbox or spam folder. Can someone manually reset it for me?

tickets.subject: Starter kit still not here
tickets.body: Ordered the starter kit two weeks ago and delivery is taking forever. The tracking page still just says 'in transit' with no city or date attached.

tickets.subject: Dashboard dark mode request
tickets.body: Would you consider adding a dark mode to the account dashboard? Staring at the bright white background at night is rough.

tickets.subject: Need to update shipping address before it ships
tickets.body: I just moved apartments and my next box is scheduled to go out Friday. Can you update my shipping address before it leaves the warehouse? Same building, new unit number.

tickets.subject: Shipment delayed, no update in over a week
tickets.body: The shipping page said my order was delayed, apparently due to weather, but that was ten days ago and there's been nothing since. Getting worried it's stuck somewhere.

tickets.subject: Cancel and refund my subscription
tickets.body: I've decided I don't need the monthly subscription anymore. Please cancel it and let me know if a partial refund for this month is possible.

tickets.subject: Blender motor died after 3 uses
tickets.body: The blender that came in my last box stopped working entirely after only three uses. It just hums and doesn't spin. This seems like a defect, not normal wear.

tickets.subject: 12 days and still no package
tickets.body: My order still hasn't arrived. It's been 12 days since I placed it and the tracking page just says 'pending' with no movement at all. Where is it?

tickets.subject: Wrong color sent
tickets.body: I ordered the kettle in black and received the white one instead. Everything else in the box was correct, just the wrong color on this one item.

tickets.subject: How do I cancel my monthly plan?
tickets.body: I can't find the cancel button anywhere in account settings. Can you point me to it or cancel it on your end?

tickets.subject: Box never showed up
tickets.body: Tracking hasn't updated in over a week and the box never showed up. I'm starting to think it's lost somewhere between the warehouse and here.

tickets.subject: Promo code not applying
tickets.body: I'm trying to use the code SAVE20 at checkout but it says invalid even though the email said it's valid through the end of the month.

tickets.subject: Love the new packaging!
tickets.body: Just wanted to say the redesigned packaging in this month's box is gorgeous. The recyclable insert is a really nice touch too.

tickets.subject: Mobile app crashes on settings tab
tickets.body: Every time I tap into the settings tab on the iOS app it crashes immediately. Happens consistently, app version 3.2.1.

tickets.subject: Item arrived cracked
tickets.body: The package showed up on time but the ceramic mug inside was cracked down the middle. Must have happened in transit. Can you send a replacement?

tickets.subject: Second late order in a row
tickets.body: The carrier says my shipment is delayed in transit, no new scan in six days. This is the second month in a row my order has been late -- what's going on?

tickets.subject: Export order history as CSV
tickets.body: Is there a way to export my full order history as a CSV file? I'd like it for my own budgeting spreadsheet.

tickets.subject: Card declined but still charged
tickets.body: Checkout told me my card was declined, but I can see the charge on my statement anyway. Did the order actually go through?

tickets.subject: Do you ship to Canada?
tickets.body: Thinking about subscribing but I'm based in Toronto. Do you currently ship to Canadian addresses, and is there an extra customs fee?

tickets.subject: Gift packaging option
tickets.body: Would love a plain gift-wrap packaging option at checkout for boxes I'm sending to someone else, without the invoice showing the price.

tickets.subject: 2FA code never arrives via SMS
tickets.body: I have two-factor authentication turned on and the SMS code never arrives. I've tried resending it five times. Can you disable 2FA on my account temporarily?

tickets.subject: Merge two accounts
tickets.body: I accidentally signed up twice with two different emails. Can you merge the accounts so my subscription history is in one place?

tickets.subject: Is the coffee grinder dishwasher safe?
tickets.body: Quick question before I use it -- is the burr grinder from last month's box dishwasher safe, or hand-wash only?

tickets.subject: Refund hasn't posted to my bank
tickets.body: You confirmed my refund ten days ago but I still don't see it in my bank account. My bank says they have no record of it. Can you check the transaction ID?

tickets.subject: Great support experience
tickets.body: Just wanted to say the support agent I chatted with yesterday resolved my billing issue in about five minutes. Really appreciated the quick, friendly help.

tickets.subject: Checkout page slow on mobile
tickets.body: The checkout page takes 10-15 seconds to load on my phone every time, both on wifi and cellular. Desktop is fine. Might be worth looking into.

tickets.subject: Package stuck at depot for a week
tickets.body: My package has been sitting at the local carrier depot for over a week without moving. Extremely frustrated with how slow this delivery has been -- it was supposed to arrive five days ago.
